headline: Will the War Resume Before the Midterms? Latest Odds
status: Iran soft-rejected the US counter on Oct. 4: it wants the strait settled and US steps first, and won't discuss nuclear terms yet. Another tanker was hit in Hormuz, unclaimed, and every B-1B has left RAF Fairford. The deadlock is still sequencing.
change_note: Since Sept. 30: war +2 (+3, then −1 after the B-1B exit), limbo +1, half-open −1, deal −2.
